author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia has introduced monthly utilization statements for cloud providers participating in its neocloud revenue-sharing program. The first statements will cover September usage and will be issued in October.

The reporting step extends the model described by CFO Colette Kress, in which Nvidia receives proceeds from infrastructure sales and a share of rental revenue when third parties use the compute capacity.

The new statements will separate third-party usage from capacity consumed by Nvidia itself. They do not change the previously reported $36 billion in commitments as of July 26 or the typical six-year agreement term.
headline: Nvidia Begins Monthly Utilization Reporting For Its Neocloud Revenue-Sharing Program
summary: Nvidia is adding monthly utilization statements to the neocloud program described by CFO Colette Kress, while retaining hardware sales and rental-income sharing.
